contact_hero_desc: Travel and activity agency in Algeria since 2019. We craft authentic trips from the Mediterranean coast to the Sahara.
about_p1: Founded in 2019 in Béjaïa, Algeria Travel is an agency specializing in tours, travel packages and activities across Algeria. We help individuals, families and groups discover the country differently — away from impersonal mass tourism.
about_p2: From the Kabyle coast to the Tassili dunes, through Algiers Casbah, Ghardaïa or Constantine, we offer tailor-made packages: hotels, guesthouses, guided excursions, hikes and cultural experiences. Our multilingual team works with local guides and partners to ensure safety, warm hospitality and genuine immersion.

faq_q1: What is the best time to travel?
faq_a1: Spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November) offer the best weather. The Sahara is ideal from October to April.
faq_a2: Yes, all our guides speak French and know their region perfectly. They passionately share local history and traditions.
faq_a3: We accept credit cards, international transfers, PayPal and cash payments (EUR/DZD) upon arrival.

privacy_page_desc: How Algeria Travel collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy_s1_body: When you submit a booking or contact request, we collect your name, email, phone, trip details and message. This information is used only to handle your request.
privacy_s2_body: Your data is used to contact you, prepare quotes, confirm trips and manage follow-up. We do not sell it to third parties.
privacy_s3_body: Requests are kept as long as needed for business and legal purposes, then deleted or anonymised.
privacy_s4_body: You may request access, correction or deletion of your data by emailing us.
